purpose: Reject smooth-looking scenery deformation as well as stepped animation. No numeric quality score inferred from structural metrics.
minimum_duration: One-second micro-study by default. Six-second UI fallback requires verified minimum and has a declared1-6s quiet tail. Review the moving interval separately from that tail.

review_order.reject: Leaf/stem/berry count, branch topology, root, lighting or framing already differs materially from source.
Any visible ground flow, hill breathing, changing path width, shifted paving or house/rock movement. Check interior as well as silhouette.
Only a highlight patch moves, the plant slides rigidly, or roots detach. Trace major branches and leaf attachments throughout.
Long repeated poses punctuated by jumps, stalled mid-bend, discontinuous reversals. Inspect full speed and adjacent frames; average fps alone proves nothing.
Global exposure, saturation or hue pulse; branch undersides changing visibility must be distinguished from grade drift.
A visible first/last transition, mismatched velocity at seam, or crossfade ghosting. Similar endpoints alone are insufficient.
Aseprite reconstruction fails to retain the reviewed motion or introduces root/path leakage. Validate at actual screen size with all ambient layers active.

integration_policy: Keep Grok originals as motion reference. Author complete coherent sprites, never turn a video crop containing ground into a warped runtime tile. Use enough distinct cels for the chosen motion; do not duplicate frames to meet a count. Start at24 for broad plant cycles and increase only where visual cadence requires it. Preserve editable rest art and clean static ground.
known_counterexample: castle_approach_bank retired cels change793 pixels in the ten-pixel source-space uphill-path corridor, max56codes; source diagnostic pending GPU confirmation.
